_doc: Rules and sources: money/TAX.md (checked 2026-10-24). Rates are estimates; a CPA checks the method once before the first quarterly payment. Prices change only with TJ's OK.

sales_tax.form: ET-1 sales and use tax return (ATAP)
sales_tax.how: Sign in to ATAP, pick the sales and use tax account, File return, type the numbers above, pay by bank draft.

federal.how: IRS Direct Pay: Make a payment, reason Estimated Tax, apply to 1040ES, tax year above, then the amount. Save the confirmation number.

arkansas.how: ATAP: Make a payment (no login needed), Individual income tax, Estimated payment, tax year above, then the amount.

franchise.how: Arkansas Secretary of State business site: file the LLC franchise tax report and pay the $150. Late adds $25 plus interest.

receptionist.label: AI receptionist, $149 or $249 a month
receptionist.why: Software used online, nothing downloaded. Arkansas rule GR-25 doesn't tax it (likely; DFA asked in writing).

setup.label: Setup fee, $299
setup.why: Setting up a non-taxable service. Not on Arkansas's list of taxed services.

site.label: Website build or hosting
site.why: Custom programming and hosting aren't taxed services in Arkansas (GR-25(H)(2)).

monitoring.label: Gym security, $200 a month + $100 per extra entrance
monitoring.why: Security and alarm monitoring is taxed (rule GR-9.12). Treated as taxed until DFA says otherwise.

hardware.label: Camera kit sold at cost, about $275
hardware.why: Goods are taxed. Buy the kit tax-free for resale (form ST391 with the permit number), charge the gym 9.5%.

install.label: Install labor, billed on its own
install.why: Alarm install isn't taxed (GR-9.12) when it's a separate line on the invoice.

deadlines.title: Bentonville business registry renewal
steps: Renew between Nov 1 and Dec 31 each year (new businesses: within 60 days of starting).
Fee: $15 a year per the city FAQ (check). Working from home as a Type A home occupation may be exempt (check with Planning, 479-271-3122).
deadlines.how: City business registry online, or email businessregistry@bentonvillear.com.

deadlines.title: 1099-NEC to anyone paid $2,000+
steps: Only if a contractor got $2,000 or more from the business last year (2026 rule; check).
Get a W-9 from every contractor before the first payment.
deadlines.how: IRS IRIS portal, free. Copy to the contractor the same day.

deadlines.title: Yearly returns: 1040 + Schedule C/SE, Arkansas AR1000F
steps: Jarvis packs the year's income, card charges and estimates paid from money/tax and money/budget.
Hand it to the CPA, or file it yourself.
deadlines.how: Through the CPA or IRS-approved software. Arkansas follows a federal extension.

deadlines.title: Business insurance renewal
steps: Compare 2 quotes 30 days before. Tech E&O + general liability.
deadlines.how: Renew with the current insurer, or switch.
